_meta.calendar_summary: Duggan Bachelor Party — Panama City Jul 16–19
_meta.calendar_description: Bachelor party itinerary for Laurence Duggan. JW Marriott Panama, Jul 16–19, 2026. Subscribe to get all locked events + opt-in menu options on your calendar. Questions: contact George Mensing or Laurence Duggan.

hotel.name: JW Marriott Panama
hotel.address: Calle Isaac Hannono Missri, Punta Pacifica, Panama City, Panama
hotel.reservation_note: Rooms booked + paid by George Mensing. You will receive an individual confirmation email from JW Marriott; bring a photo ID to the front desk. Breakfast included.

_meta.dress_code_note: Some bars/clubs/restaurants require pants + nice shoes for nights.
_meta.weather_note: Hot. Brief afternoon rain typical in July.
_meta.transport_note: Uber works throughout the city. A party-bus option may be coordinated by George (status TBD).

events.summary: Arrival window — fly into PTY (Tocumen Intl)
events.description: Most attendees arrive Thursday afternoon. Plan to be at the JW by ~6pm for the group dinner at 7pm. Uber from Tocumen International Airport (PTY) to JW Marriott Panama takes ~30–45 min depending on traffic; cost ~$30–40 USD.
events.location: Tocumen International Airport (PTY), Panama City

events.description: JW Marriott Panama — Calle Isaac Hannono Missri, Punta Pacifica, Panama City, Panama. Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/?q=JW+Marriott+Panama+Punta+Pacifica. Check-in 3:00 PM, Check-out 11:00 AM. Rooms booked + paid by George Mensing. You will receive an individual confirmation email from JW Marriott directly; bring photo ID to the front desk for walk-up check-in. Breakfast included daily at MASI restaurant on-site. Honoree: Laurence. Organizer: George Mensing.
events.location: JW Marriott Panama, Calle Isaac Hannono Missri, Punta Pacifica, Panama City, Panama

events.description: Standard 3:00 PM check-in. Walk to front desk with photo ID. Rooms are booked + paid by George Mensing. You will receive a confirmation email from JW Marriott directly. Breakfast included daily at MASI restaurant on-site.
events.location: JW Marriott Panama, Calle Isaac Hannono Missri, Punta Pacifica, Panama City, Panama

events.summary: Depart JW → Aya La Vida (Casco Viejo)
events.description: Uber to Casco Viejo, ~15–20 min from JW. Plan to leave the lobby together at 6:30 PM for the 7:00 PM reservation. Coordinate Uber carpools in the group chat.
events.location: JW Marriott Panama lobby — pickup point

events.description: Reservation for the group at Aya La Vida — Panamanian cuisine in Casco Viejo. Live music + dancing on Thursdays. Famous for tableside theatrics (steak tartare, rum flambé). Reservation status: TBD — confirm with George/Laurence before the trip. Web: https://restaurantpanama.com/. Dress code: smart casual. Ave price ~$30–60/person.
events.location: Aya La Vida, Casco Viejo, Panama City

events.description: Casco Viejo rum bar — walk from Aya La Vida (~5–10 min). https://pedromandinga.com/. Locally distilled rum, cocktails, lively atmosphere. Pre-game for the cigar bar.
events.location: Pedro Mandinga, Casco Viejo, Panama City

events.summary: Cigar bar — Valentino Siesto Club House
events.description: Casco Viejo cigar lounge — walking distance from Pedro Mandinga. https://www.instagram.com/valentinosiestoclubhouse/. Smoke + whiskey/scotch to close night 1. Take Uber back to JW when done.
events.location: Valentino Siesto Club House, Casco Viejo, Panama City

events.description: Launch point TBD — most catamaran charters depart from the Amador Causeway marinas (Flamenco / La Playita) ~15 min from JW. Confirm exact pier with George. Allow time for traffic + group muster. Bring: swimsuit, sunscreen, hat, dry bag for phone. Breakfast at the hotel before departure (MASI opens early; included).
events.location: JW Marriott Panama lobby — pickup point

events.description: Private catamaran for the group. 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM (return time flexible — it's our boat for the day). Panamanian BBQ on board + open bar to and from the island. Beach time at Taboga. Reference itinerary: https://tinyurl.com/p5z7ytcb (actual boat + operator TBD — confirm with George). Bring sunscreen, hat, swimsuit, dry bag.
events.location: Panama Bay — Taboga Island

events.description: Return to launch point + Uber to JW. Decompress, shower before Friday dinner.
events.location: Amador Causeway marina → JW Marriott Panama

events.summary: [OPT-IN A] Friday dinner — La Barbara x Aki (Casco Viejo)
events.description: OPT-IN, ~6–8 spots. Sushi + craft cocktails in a hidden Casco Viejo speakeasy-style lounge. Light food after the catamaran BBQ. Smart casual dress. Reservation: needs to be booked (do not walk up). https://www.opentable.com/r/la-barbara-panama-city. Opt-in via the flight form's notes field OR ping Laurence by Wed Jul 15. Walks into the Friday rooftop bar crawl after.
events.location: La Barbara x Aki, Calle 10 & Av B, Casco Viejo, Panama City

events.summary: [OPT-IN B] Friday dinner — Mercado de Marisco (Fish Market)
events.description: OPT-IN, no cap, walk-in. Iconic Panama fish market on the Cinta Costera. Pick your seafood at the stalls, they grill it; ceviche stalls outside. High-energy, casual, quintessential Panama. https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g294480-d2589867-Reviews-Mercado_Publico_del_Marisco-Panama_City_Panama_Province.html. Easy roll into the Casco Viejo rooftop bar crawl after (~10 min walk to Casco).
events.location: Mercado de Marisco, Cinta Costera, Panama City

events.summary: [OPT-IN C] Friday dinner — Tacos Cholula (Punta Pacifica, near JW)
events.description: OPT-IN, no cap, walk-in. Casual tacos within walking distance of the JW. For anyone wrecked by the sun, this is the no-Uber, low-effort option. Catch up with the group at the rooftop bar crawl later via Uber.
events.location: Tacos Cholula, Punta Pacifica, Panama City

events.summary: Depart for Casco Viejo → rooftop bar crawl
events.description: Group muster point: Tantalo Rooftop, Calle 8 & Av B, Casco Viejo. Uber from JW or post-dinner location.
events.location: Tantalo Rooftop, Casco Viejo, Panama City

events.description: The signature Friday night. Hop between Casco Viejo rooftops with city + ocean views. Guide reference: https://cascoviejo360.com/rooftop-bars-at-night-a-casco-viejo-state-of-mind/. Dress: pants + nice shoes. Pacing: ~3–4 rooftops over 3 hours.
events.location: Casco Viejo, Panama City

events.description: OPT-IN for the late-night crowd. Venue: Le Palace (Bellavista) — ~15 min Uber from Casco Viejo. Alternates if the group wants to swap: Teatro Amador (Casco Viejo nightclub w/ themed shows, 2-floor) or La Gruta Azul (more high-energy floor). Wake-up call for Saturday daytime activities is real — plan accordingly.
events.location: Le Palace, Bellavista, Panama City

events.description: TRACK A opt-in only. Uber from JW to the Miraflores Visitor Center. ~30 min drive. Buy tickets online in advance: https://visitcanaldepanama.com/en/points-of-interest/miraflores-visitor-center/.
events.location: JW Marriott Panama lobby — pickup point

events.summary: [TRACK A] Panama Canal — Miraflores Locks tour
events.description: TRACK A: Locks tour. Watch ships transit the locks; museum + observation deck. All tracks reconvene at the Mercado de Marisco (fish market) for a 1:00 PM group lunch. https://visitcanaldepanama.com/en/points-of-interest/miraflores-visitor-center/.
events.location: Miraflores Visitor Center, Panama Canal

events.summary: [TRACK B] Depart JW → Tactical shooting range
events.description: TRACK B opt-in only. Range: Top Gun Panamá (https://topgunpanama.com) — bachelor-party-friendly experience packages w/ 9mm pistol, AR15, 12ga shotgun, revolver. Bring valid photo ID. Allow Uber time + check-in.
events.location: JW Marriott Panama lobby — pickup point

events.description: TRACK B: Tactical shooting at Top Gun Panamá (https://topgunpanama.com). Bachelor-party-friendly tourist experience with multi-weapon packages (9mm, AR15, 12ga, revolver). Bring valid photo ID; tourists do NOT need a Panama firearms permit for supervised range experiences. All tracks reconvene at the Mercado de Marisco (fish market) for a 1:00 PM group lunch.
events.location: Top Gun Panamá, Panama City

events.summary: [ALL TRACKS] Lunch — Mercado de Marisco (Fish Market)
events.description: Combined lunch for ALL Saturday daytime tracks (A Locks / B Shooting / C Golf). Whichever track you opt into, you land here at 1:00 PM for the group lunch. Pick your seafood at the stalls, they grill it. Casual, no reservation needed. ~10 min from Casco Viejo, ~15 min from JW. https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g294480-d2589867-Reviews-Mercado_Publico_del_Marisco-Panama_City_Panama_Province.html.
events.location: Mercado de Marisco, Cinta Costera, Panama City

events.description: TRACK C opt-in only. Course: Santa María Golf Club (Jack Nicklaus design, Costa del Este) — ~15 min from JW, par-72, 7,153 yds, Troon-managed. Early 7 AM Uber to beat heat + Panama afternoon rain.
events.location: JW Marriott Panama lobby — pickup point

events.summary: [TRACK C] Golf — Santa María Golf Club (Jack Nicklaus)
events.description: TRACK C: Golf, 18 holes at Santa María Golf Club — Jack Nicklaus design, Troon-managed, par-72, 7,153 yds from the back tees. Sat green fee ~$175 + tax; equipment rental ~$50 + tax. Pace-of-play target: 4.5 hrs to hit the 12:30 wrap. Coordinate via the opt-in form or ping Laurence by Thu Jul 2. All tracks reconvene at the Mercado de Marisco (fish market) for a 1:00 PM group lunch — Uber straight from the course.
events.location: Santa María Golf Club, Costa del Este, Panama City

events.summary: Hotel decompress — pool / shower / nap before Gaucho's
events.description: Free time at JW after the group fish-market lunch. Pool deck (Azul Restaurant has the poolside bar), shower, change into dinner clothes (pants + nice shoes for Gaucho's). Don't be late for 7 PM.
events.location: JW Marriott Panama, Punta Pacifica

events.description: Gaucho's is on Calle Uruguay, ~10 min from JW. Coordinate Uber carpools. Dress: pants + nice shoes.
events.location: JW Marriott Panama lobby — pickup point

events.description: RESERVATION FOR 11 — DO NOT MISS. Gaucho's Steakhouse on Calle Uruguay. World-famous Argentine parrilla. https://www.instagram.com/gauchossteakhousepty/. Reservation confirmation #: TBD (confirm with George). Dress: pants + nice shoes (enforced). Standout cuts: bife de chorizo, 16oz filete en trozo.
events.location: Gaucho's Steakhouse, Calle Uruguay, Panama City

events.description: Specific venue TBD (taking the pulse day-of). Reference Casco Viejo options from the May 28 organizer email; final pick coordinated by George/Laurence at dinner.
events.location: Panama City

events.description: Close the night at a casino. Specific casino TBD (Casco Viejo or near hotel). Bring ID. Be honest with yourself about your tolerance — Sunday departures will hurt.
events.location: Panama City

events.description: Final hangs at MASI (JW breakfast — included). Send-off + photos before flights. Some attendees stay through Mon Jul 20 (George stays through Monday). Format: floating drop-in; pop down whenever you're up.
events.location: MASI Restaurant, JW Marriott Panama (lobby level)

events.description: Standard 11:00 AM checkout. Drop bags at concierge if your flight is later. Settle any incidentals at the front desk.
events.location: JW Marriott Panama, Calle Isaac Hannono Missri, Punta Pacifica, Panama City, Panama

events.summary: Departure window — fly out of PTY
events.description: Most attendees depart Sunday afternoon/evening. Some stay through Mon Jul 20 (George). Uber from JW to Tocumen International (PTY) takes ~30–45 min; cost ~$30–40 USD. Drop your flight info via the form on the bachelor party site so we can coordinate carpools.
events.location: Tocumen International Airport (PTY), Panama City
